crear.empezarOtroConfirmar: Delete the current deck and start another? Its photos will be removed from this device.
crear.empezarOtroConPedido: This deck already has an order. If you start another one, this deck and its photos will be deleted from this device and you won’t be able to open it here again. Start another?

guardado.sinEspacio: Not saved: this device is out of space
guardado.error: Not saved: something went wrong while saving
guardado.conflicto: Not saved: the deck changed in another tab
guardado.avisoSinEspacio: Your latest changes weren’t saved: this device is out of space. Free up some space and try again, and keep this tab open in the meantime.
guardado.avisoError: Your latest changes weren’t saved on this device. Try again, and keep this tab open in the meantime.
guardado.avisoConflicto: You’ve changed this deck in another tab. So those changes aren’t overwritten, this tab has stopped saving: load the latest version and carry on from there.
guardado.avisoOtroMazo: You’ve started another deck in another tab. So it isn’t overwritten, this tab has stopped saving.

sinConexion.aviso: You’re offline: carry on, everything is saved on this device.

error.texto: Your deck is safe on this device. Try again, and if it keeps failing, reload the page.
error.sinConexion: It looks like you’re offline, and this part needs the internet to load. Your deck is safe on this device: try again once you’re back online.

avisoPack.cambiado: We’ve moved your deck to the {pack} pack: {n} cards included. Your cards stay as they are.
avisoPack.conPedido: This deck has already been ordered, so it keeps its pack. If you’d like another one with the {pack} pack, start a new deck.

packs.ayuda: Each pack includes a set number of cards: that’s the minimum to order. Add more and each one is charged separately at the pack’s price. And if a bigger pack works out cheaper for your cards, we apply it automatically.
packs.teFaltan: {n, plural, one {# more card needed} other {# more cards needed}}

ofertas.subir: With {n, plural, one {# more card} other {# more cards}} you move up to the {pack} pack for just {diferencia} more.
ofertas.subirDetalle: With {n, plural, one {# more card} other {# more cards}} you move up to the {pack} pack: just {diferencia} more, {ahorro} less than adding them one by one.
ofertas.subirMenos: With {n, plural, one {# more card} other {# more cards}} you move up to the {pack} pack and pay {menos} less than now.
ofertas.subirIgual: With {n, plural, one {# more card} other {# more cards}} you move up to the {pack} pack and pay the same as now.
ofertas.packAplicado: We’ve applied the {pack} pack: you save {ahorro}.
ofertas.packAplicadoDetalle: With this many cards the {pack} pack works out cheaper, so we’ve applied it: you save {ahorro}.
ofertas.bajar: With the {pack} pack you could already check out ({total}).

recuerdo.fechaAyuda: If you don’t know it now, you can add it later.
